Job Description  
 The individual will be responsible for Complex IT and EHS related projects, maintaining and implementing improvements, adding robustness, scalability, 
 and managing and clearing integration errors, developing reports/queries and ensuring security compliance. 
 

 Required Qualifications (list in order of priority):  
 • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, MIS or related field. 
 • At least 2+ years’ experience working with the application EnablOn and the associated application builder/configuration engine.  

 • (Direct experience with this product is required). 
 • Technical Skills - SQL Server, SSAS, SSIS, SSRS, EnablOn Application Builder/Configuration Engine Development 
 • Soft Skills – Excellent written and verbal communications skills 
 • Other – Deep understanding of relational databases, software development and web applications.
 Regards,
 Asma Khan Suri.
 



 Must be able to pass a background and drug screen
